shots.title: Require ticket-key or implementation-shaped evidence before a sprint counts as shipped (#573)

hazards.description: The first pnpm verification path removed node_modules and hit better-sqlite3 native build approval in a noninteractive shell; repaired by reinstalling dependencies, approving builds, and rebuilding native bindings.

shots.notes: Bare sprint references now count as shipped evidence only when the commit subject has an implementation-shaped conventional type; nonzero ticket keys still count directly.

shots.title: Ignore docs and planning-only sprint mentions without losing true shipped detections (#573)
shots.notes: Roadmap and planning scoped bare sprint references are ignored when the subject is clearly reslotting, scoping, or triaging future work, while real implementation subjects still count.

shots.title: Add roadmap validate regressions for docs-only references and real ticket-key commits (#573)
shots.notes: Added git-backed roadmap validate regressions proving docs-only planned references do not trigger shipped-sprint errors and real ticket-key commits still do.

conditions.description: Issue #573 exposed a signal-integrity bug: roadmap validation was treating docs and planning references as shipped sprint evidence.

training.description: Bare sprint references in git history need evidence before they can be treated as shipped work.
training.outcome: extractSprintReferences now requires implementation-shaped commit subjects for bare sprint refs, while preserving direct ticket-key detection.

training.description: Planning and roadmap commits often mention future sprint numbers by design.
training.outcome: roadmap/planning scoped reslotting, scoping, spike, and triage subjects no longer create false shipped-sprint validation errors.

nutrition.description: `./node_modules/.bin/vitest.cmd run tests/core/analyzers/git.test.ts` passed after the shipped-reference detector changes.
`./node_modules/.bin/vitest.cmd run tests/cli/roadmap.test.ts tests/core/analyzers/git.test.ts` passed: 2 files, 65 tests.

`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` initially hit native build approval friction after node_modules was removed; `pnpm approve-builds --all` restored the better-sqlite3 binding and generated pnpm-workspace.yaml was removed.

nineteenth_hole.how_did_it_feel: A narrow but important signal repair: the roadmap was reading planning breadcrumbs as shipped reality.
nineteenth_hole.advice_for_next_player: When a validator consumes git history, separate exact ticket evidence from broad narrative mentions before making roadmap state decisions.
nineteenth_hole.what_surprised_you: The false positives came from useful planning commits, not bad data; the detector needed context instead of a broader regex.
nineteenth_hole.excited_about_next: S217 can now tackle stale workflow cleanup without roadmap validation confusing recovery planning with completed implementation.

bunker_locations: Docs-only and roadmap-planning commits can mention sprint numbers without shipping sprint work.
Bare sprint references need implementation-shaped subjects; ticket keys remain the stronger evidence.
pnpm 11 build approval can block native dependencies in noninteractive repair paths after node_modules is removed.
yardage_book_updates: src/core/analyzers/git.ts now filters bare sprint references through implementation-shaped conventional commit subjects.
src/core/analyzers/git.ts suppresses roadmap/planning scoped reslotting and scoping references without suppressing true implementation subjects.
tests/core/analyzers/git.test.ts covers ticket-key retention, docs-only bare sprint rejection, implementation-shaped bare sprint refs, and planning-only subjects.
tests/cli/roadmap.test.ts covers git-backed roadmap validate behavior for planned sprint mentions and real ticket-key commits.
course_management_notes: GitHub issue #573 is addressed by commits a2974a2, cd346c7, and 67208cd.
The sprint intentionally leaves unrelated dirty hook and slope-loop files untouched.
